description: NaErO₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ErO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ErO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. Er³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form ErO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ErO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Er-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Er³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Er₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
